title: LIT, stop beyond the 1m protected swing (+1 tick), LIT size rule
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: upsizing and fewer wide stops - do tighter stops or more contracts pay on LIT?
verdict: Median stop 14-17 pts, so the LIT rule puts ~$740 at risk instead of ~$270: the H1 $ come from 2.7x the risk. H2 and 2021-25 lose. 2026 H1 (pick) n=80 3.12/wk win 12.5% PF 4.13 net +81,328 ($13,343/mo) DD -9,386 median stop 14.375 pts, 25.5 micros, $735 at risk; eval 2wk 43.0/39.8 1mo 45.3/40.6 pass rate 52.7% median 4.0; 2026 H2 (check) n=40 2.56/wk win 10.0% PF 1.47 net +6,356 ($1,711/mo) DD -8,842 median stop 17.125 pts, 21.5 micros, $745 at risk; eval 2wk 21.8/43.6 1mo 21.8/53.8 pass rate 36.4% median 5.5; 2021-25 reference only n=510 2.38/wk win 8.2% PF 0.84 net -30,338 ($-594/mo) DD -46,441 median stop 17.25 pts, 22.0 micros, $708 at risk; eval 2wk 12.3/46.0 1mo 15.0/75.7 pass rate 16.0% median 5.0
notes: tools/lit_tightstop.py (wraps engine/lit.py; stop_mode ext + LIT size == run lit_live trade for trade). Same LIT signals and fills; the stop, entry limit or size changes. MFFU $1,000 soft daily loss modelled; NQ minis at $4.50 a round trip.
